summary: The candidate skill 'Legacy Session Compatibility Bridge' is semantically a narrower, internal-facing variant of the peer candidate 'Legacy Module State Synchronization' (which handles the same synchronization but with ImportError gracefully). Additionally, the exit handler registration logic in the candidate overlaps with the peer 'Exit Handler Registration for Trace Cleanup'. The candidate should merge into these two existing skills rather than persist as a separate micro_skill, as it represents implementation details of the same compatibility maintenance task at the same asset level and stage.
